newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines unable to meet oil drilling targets.
newsitem.headline: Philippines unable to meet oil drilling targets.

text.p: The Philippine Department of Energy said on Tuesday it will fail to meet its target of having nine exploratory oil wells drilled this year.
Department oil and gas chief Ismael Ocampo told Reuters that only three wells are expected to be drilled this year.
"Most of the oil exploration firms who committed to drill wells are rethinking their work programmes and some want additional seismic surveys conducted," Ocampo said.
Cophil Exploration Corp and Occidental Philippines Inc each drilled a wildcat well early this year. Both were plugged and abandoned as they failed to yield significant hydrocarbons.
Ocampo said the well being drilled by the Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp at Maniguin in the central Philippines will probably be the last one to be spudded this year.
